status: re-checked against the built outputs 2026-10-16 (Stage 6) — supersedes the MSG 362 proposal where they differ

conventions.paths: dot paths into each subcommand's JSON; [] = per array element; '*' = every subcommand listed under 'placement_carriers'
conventions.nulls: a field whose value is unknown is present as null with a sibling *_reason where the contract names a reason

keys.s1_class_v_flag: true on every S1 read (S1 is a class-V table)
keys.low_gravity_class: bool — a III/IV read as a low-gravity designation (ruling 133 M5)
keys.bc_key: string — kept; now the type read

keys.bcLuminosity: number|null — the region L (L_sun), unchanged key
keys.lum_route_reason: string — why the route (e.g. 'V-J outside 2.53-6.98', 'no 2MASS identifier in SIMBAD', 'more than one 2MASS identifier', 'giant/subgiant class')
keys.lum_colour_paths: {bc_v: number, bc_k: number} — the two path L values
keys.twomass: {designation, j, e_j, ks, e_ks, ph_qual, rd_flg, quality_below_a: [bands]}|null
keys.lum_route_disagreement: bool — max/min of the two routes' L > 1.40
keys.lum_route_note: string — on a colour-route result only (absent on the subtype route): the colour route's disclosure — Mann et al. 2015 Table 3 base rows on V − J (no [Fe/H] term), the mean of the BC_V and BC_K paths at Mann's zero point 4.755 (×1.014 against S1's 4.74, disclosed) (MSG 366 F-4)

simbad_markers.simbad_status_a: 'failed' — present ONLY when component A's SIMBAD lookup failed as a service error (not 'No results found') where the mass chain needed the record: the widening lookup of a reduced primary record (run only when the M_Ks tier is reached), or the primary lookup on binary-stability-auto coordinate / source-id input; with not_authoritative (MSG 368 O-1)
simbad_markers.simbad_status_b: 'failed' — component B's lookup failed as a service error; on binary-stability-auto and the dossier multiplicity block only when no manual / catalog / FLAME tier gave B a mass, on exclusion-system --star whatever the tier (B's record also carries its WD / BD class), with a note in place of 'companion nature not confirmed'; with not_authoritative
simbad_markers.where: top level of binary-stability-auto; the dossier multiplicity block; exclusion-system --star binary (simbad_status_b only)

disclosure_not_degrade.twomass_ids_multiple: [string] — present only when SIMBAD lists more than one '2MASS' identifier (the route not taken)

twomass_markers.where: top level of star-regions, dossier, exclusion-boundary, exclusion-system (single body), dyson-collector, par-flux, generate-system (an error carrying the marker — a deliberate deviation, reported to WB); per star on compare-stars stars[] and circumbinary-hz stars[]; twomass_status_a / _b + not_authoritative on exclusion-system (binary), binary-stability-auto and the dossier multiplicity block

mass_provenance_new_values.note: unchanged: ms_luminosity_inversion (the L route), spectral_type_table (--spectral-type / type route), catalog, gaia_flame, manual, object_preset

detection_completeness_star_mass_provena.catalog: the new catalog tier (--star-mass-catalog or the internal seed)

keys.mass_route: 'mks' | 'luminosity' | 'sol_pinned' (sol-regions / the Sol dossier) | null (a tier above inference)
keys.mass_relation: 'Eker2018_inverted' | 'S1_sequence' | 'Mann2019_n5' | null (a tier above inference; the --spectral-type path reads S1's Msun directly and emits no mass_relation)
keys.mass_lroute_solar: number|null — the L route's mass, reported beside the M_Ks mass
keys.mks_binary_disclosure: string — S13 unresolved-binary hazard, on every M_Ks-route output
keys.mks: {status, mass, m_ks, ...} — the region step's M_Ks-route record (star-regions top level; carried on a failed region step too)
keys.mass_mks_solar (beside a higher tier): on dossier regions.mass and compare-stars stars[]: the M_Ks mass reported beside an adopted catalog / FLAME mass (not adopted), with mks_binary_disclosure
keys.region_step_note: string — exclusion-boundary --star: the region step's failure reason when the mass came from another tier (ruling 164)

keys.ms_lifetime_yr | ms_lifetime_gyr: number|null — as each site has its lifespan today (star-regions lifeSpan keeps its key)
keys.ms_lifetime_if_stellar_ge_yr: number|null — the t(M_hi) of a boundary note
keys.carriers_detail: star-regions: mainSeqLifeSpan + ms_lifetime_* top level; dossier: regions.stellar.main_seq_lifespan_yr + ms_lifetime_*; every placement object: placement.lifetime.{ms_lifetime_*}

lifetime.stellar-evolution: T_ms and every stage duration move to MIST; additive t_ms_gyr + ms_lifetime_end_point (the 0.62 Msun band reads interpolated_1e-2_to_1e-4 — contract CR-30.5 acceptance 1; live pre-check)

placement_carriers.exclusion-system: zones[].components[].placement (null for a white dwarf / rogue component)
placement_carriers.dossier: data.regions.mass.placement (the one path — WB MSG 363's request); multiplicity.placement_a
placement_carriers.binary-orbit / multiplicity / close-bina: companion class + direction keys (no placement object)

keys.status_text: 'stellar' | 'boundary — star or brown dwarf uncertain' | 'substellar' | 'stellar, pre-main-sequence' | 'undetermined — no mass' | 'undetermined (minimum mass)' (an SB1-minimum orbit mass)
keys.reading: 'x' | 'le_x' | 'interval' | 'ge_x' (an SB1-minimum orbit mass — a lower bound)
keys.reading_text: e.g. '<= 0.4631 (young — the field relation over-reads)' | 'young — no measurable over-read here (BHAC15)' | 'young — the field relation under-reads here; no bound from the main-sequence relations' | 'pre-MS — no bound from the main-sequence relations'
keys.basis_unknown: bool — a catalog row without mass_basis, or an archive mass
keys.no_sizing_age_reason: string|null — e.g. 'no lower age bound — boundary assumes the youngest ages are possible'
keys.reading_node_gyr: number|null — the node whose factor set the reading (Greg's Q18 one-node case)
keys.youth_rule_applies: bool — inference / relation / archive rows only
keys.catalog_age: {lo_gyr, hi_gyr, basis, grade} — the matched catalog row's age, when it has one
keys.age_input: {lo_gyr, hi_gyr, basis} — on a component / dossier / detection placement when an age was given

flags.--age-hi-gyr: float; required to give an age
flags.--age-basis: membership | lithium | gravity_class | model_fit; required with an age

on: dossier (incl. Sol; reaches the multiplicity block — Q33)
age_input.compare-stars: --star-age NAME LO HI BASIS (repeatable; LO may be 'none'; NAME matches a --stars entry, Sol included)
age_input.echo: age_input {lo_gyr, hi_gyr, basis}: top level on exclusion-boundary / exclusion-system / star-regions / binary-stability-auto; inside placement on exclusion-system components, the dossier and detection-completeness; stars[].age_input on compare-stars
age_input.errors: curated, exit 1, text prefixed 'age input: ' (an --age-basis outside the four is argparse exit 2)

domain.by_placement: exclusion_wall.placed_domain_kw: placement substellar → windless_free_harbor (class_note 'substellar by placement …'); undetermined_no_mass → the 5th value; stellar / boundary keep main_sequence

companion_class_new_values: boundary — star or brown dwarf uncertain

keys.m1_null_reason: 'no_spectral_type' | 'letter_only_type' | 'unreadable_type' | 'outside_s1_mass_span' | 'no_simbad_lookup' — on companion blocks, binary-orbit identity, and binary-stability-auto / the dossier multiplicity block when elements are null
keys.m1_assumed_note: string — bulk Gaia-NSS census rows (1.0 Msun assumed)
keys.identity.lum_class_token / s1_class_v_fl: binary-orbit identity: the type's luminosity-class token; s1_class_v_flag true whenever S1 (a class-V table) seeded M1 (read the class from lum_class_token)
keys.elements.m1_direction / m2_direction / m: binary-stability-auto and the dossier multiplicity block, under a primary read 'le_x'
keys.companion.substellar: bool — a true mass under a flagged primary: Y < 0.067
keys.placement_a: binary-stability-auto / dossier multiplicity: the primary's placement

detection_completeness.explicit_branch: host_class null; methods[].applicable false; methods[].note names the cause — 'host placement: <status_text>' or 'host radius null — <reason>' and --star-mass-solar / --star-radius-solar; star_mass_solar = placed reading; star_radius_solar null + star_radius_null_reason; assumptions.out_of_domain true; L0-L5 with no mass: note 'undetermined — no mass', star_mass_solar null

keys.catalog_mass_not_applied: bool — non-MS host with no radius tier
keys.notes: [string] — catalog-beside-archive, archive basis unknown, catalog mass not applied

data_errors.Cr30DataError: curated error, exit 1 — missing / md5-mismatched / inconsistent CR-30 data file
data_errors.catalog_field_error: curated {"error": "stellar-mass catalog '<path>': <row>: <field> …"}, exit 1 — an invalid CR-30 catalog field (row + field named; validate_cr30_fields)

paths_by_subcommand.star-regions: top level (region keys beside bcLuminosity/stellarMass); placement
paths_by_subcommand.dossier: data.regions.* (region + parse + luminosity keys, also on a failed region step); data.regions.stellar.{luminosity_from_mass, stellar_radius} + their *_relation / *_null_reason; data.regions.mass.* (mass_route / mass_relation / mass_segment / mass_switch_band — null under a tier above inference — m_ks, mass_mks_solar, mass_lroute_solar, mass_lroute_null_reason, mks_binary_disclosure, mks_note, mks_activity_caveat); data.regions.mass.placement; on a failed region step data.regions = {region_step_failed, region_error, luminosity_class, evolved_star_flag, stellar, mass}; data.multiplicity.placement_a
paths_by_subcommand.exclusion-boundary: top level (parse, luminosity, mass keys); placement; windless_alternative under placement
paths_by_subcommand.par-flux: top level parse keys (--spectral-type Teff from S1); markers on --star
paths_by_subcommand.main-sequence: rows[] keys: SpT, Teff, B-V, Mv, BCv, logL, R_Rsun, Msun, s1_line, Mbol_computed, density_computed_gcc, density_computed_rho_sun, ms_lifetime_gyr_computed, ms_lifetime_end_point
paths_by_subcommand.binary-orbit / binary-stability-auto / m: identity.{lum_class_token, s1_class_v_flag, m1_null_reason}; solutions[].companion.{class, m1_direction, m2_direction, sb1_caveat_withheld, substellar, m1_null_reason}; binary-stability-auto placement_a + elements directions; multiplicity components[].m2_solar_lower_direction; census rows m1_assumed_note

disclosures.cr30_disclosures: {topic: text} — static, additive, on success; topics s1 / luminosity / relations / lifetime / hbl / youth

by_subcommand.exclusion-boundary: all six on --star / --spectral-type; hbl on --mass-msun; none on --object
by_subcommand.main-sequence: none (a list output; its rows carry the S1 / MIST keys)
by_subcommand.exclusion-system: all six (--star, or a --component with a type / class / lum= / main_id=); hbl when every component is a supplied mass=

disclosures.per_run: per-run disclosures ride in each output's existing notes / note fields beside the value they qualify (inventory: docs/integration.md CR-30 block)
disclosures.per_note_inventory: docs/integration.md — CR-30 block, 'Disclosure inventory' table (each contract disclosure → output note + subcommand + condition, static topic, or docs only)
